key_insight: LLM agents show broadly consistent competitive rankings across Eurogames, but game-specific strengths and execution harnesses also shape performance.
engineering_relevance: Evaluate complete model–harness configurations across tasks, tracking competitive performance alongside token use and cost.
method: Introduce DECE: ten Eurogames with shared interfaces and evaluation protocols.
Compare 12 model–harness configurations spanning nine models and four execution harnesses.
Use matched studies to examine harness-dependent performance.
evidence_signal: The primary study covers 480 three-player matches across ten games, with 1,032 completed matches across the main and supplementary studies.
watch_item: Stronger competitive performance does not consistently imply better token or cost efficiency.
paper_title: A Unified Arena for LLM Agents across Diverse Eurogame
